info.name: Al-Ameen Clinical Speech Therapy Academy API (v1)
info.description:
Complete OpenAPI / Postman v2.1 Collection for all Public, Authentication, and Student Workspace endpoints of the Al-Ameen Clinical Speech Therapy Academy LMS Platform (`/api/v1/*`).

### Quick Start
1. Set the `base_url` collection variable (defaults to `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`).
2. Run **2. Authentication & Recovery -> Login (Email & Password)** — the collection test script automatically saves the returned Sanctum token into `{{token}}`.
3. All authenticated Student endpoints automatically inherit `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` and `Accept-Language: {{locale}}`.

item.name: 1. Public & Marketing
item.description: Public platform configuration, landing page content, course catalog, reviews, contact info, SEO metadata, locale switching, and public certificate verification.

request.description: Interactive browser-based OpenAPI 3.0.3 documentation viewer powered by Scalar UI.

item.name: 2. Authentication & Recovery
item.description: Student registration, email/password login, 2FA login challenge, Firebase & Google OAuth login, WebAuthn Passkey login, and 6-digit OTP password reset.

item.name: Login via Google OAuth Access Token

request.description: Generates and dispatches a fresh 6-digit numeric OTP code via email (`EmailVerificationOtpNotification`) to the authenticated student for email address confirmation.

Verifies the authenticated student's email address using the 6-digit numeric OTP received in their email inbox.

- **Service**: `EmailVerificationOtpService::verifyOtp()`
- **Rate Limiting**: `throttle:otp`
- **Middleware**: `auth:sanctum`, `student.approved`
